summary: Master CMMS implementation training with asset data, workflows, PM schedules, and dashboards. Build practical rollout skills for maintenance teams.
lede: Computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) training covers setting up asset records and maintenance workflows. It is for CMMS administrators, maintenance planners, reliability engineers, and supervisors implementing or managing a system while operations continue. Participants practice structuring asset data, configuring work orders and preventive maintenance schedules, and building reports on backlog, compliance, and downtime, alongside pilot testing and phased rollout planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage maintenance records, asset performance, and implementation decisions inside industrial, facilities, or asset-intensive environments. It is especially relevant if you are responsible for CMMS setup, maintenance planning, reliability data, or operational reporting.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop capable of opening spreadsheets and completing template-based exercises. If your organization already uses a CMMS, having sample asset records, work order codes, or maintenance reports will help you apply the exercises more directly. No software installation is required unless a specific vendor demo environment is introduced during delivery.
